integrity: The minimum and normal form are proved by strict integer inequalities. The finite census is independently replayed in profile-first and event-first enumeration orders and checked against the symbolic ten-family classification.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for three candidates at and below the minimal tie-independent boundary, with anonymous complete strict ballots and homogeneous abstaining groups. No claim is made for fixed tie-breaking, heterogeneous abstention coalitions, incomplete rankings, or larger candidate sets.
title: Complete minimal no-show classification for three-candidate instant runoff
